name: Zendesk
summary: Search, read, comment on, and update Zendesk support tickets.

auth.setup_help: Enable token access in Zendesk (Admin → Apps and integrations → APIs → Zendesk API). The username is your agent email with '/token' appended, e.g. agent@acme.com/token, and the password is the API token.

actions.name: zendesk_search_tickets
actions.description: Search tickets with Zendesk search syntax, e.g. 'type:ticket status:open requester:jane@acme.com'.

response.projection_jmespath: results[].{id: id, subject: subject, status: status, priority: priority, requester_id: requester_id, updated: updated_at}

actions.name: zendesk_get_ticket
actions.description: Fetch one ticket by id, including its description.

response.projection_jmespath: ticket.{id: id, subject: subject, description: description, status: status, priority: priority, tags: tags}

actions.name: zendesk_list_comments
actions.description: List the comments on a ticket, oldest first - the full back-and-forth with the customer.

response.projection_jmespath: comments[].{author_id: author_id, public: public, created: created_at, body: plain_body}

actions.name: zendesk_add_comment
actions.description: Add a comment to a ticket. Set public=false for an internal note the customer will not see.

response.projection_jmespath: ticket.{id: id, status: status, updated: updated_at}

actions.name: zendesk_update_ticket
actions.description: Change a ticket's status or priority.

fields.description: new | open | pending | hold | solved | closed.

response.projection_jmespath: ticket.{id: id, status: status, priority: priority}

toolset.description: Zendesk support: search and read tickets, read conversations, reply, and update status.
